rounds.text: The company’s recent performance signals a significant deterioration in capital efficiency, as evidenced by the collapse of the return on equity to just 5% over the last year [E21], [E54]. While the historical median ROE figures of 19% and 17% suggest past strength [E19], [E20], the current reality is a sharp decline that aligns with a 0% return on assets [E8]. Investors are currently receiving no compensation for their capital in the form of dividends, as the yield is 0.00% [E4]. The market’s lack of confidence is reflected in the stock price, which languishes at only 17% of its 52-week range [E5]. Conceded: the company trades at a P/E of 16.9x [E1] and a P/B of 0.75x [E2], both of which sit below their respective sector benchmarks [E6], [E7]. Despite these valuation metrics, the downward trend in profitability and the absence of shareholder distributions present a clear risk to the investment thesis.
